description: gomodTidy re-tidies go.mod/go.sum after a dependency update. gomodUpdateImportPaths is the half that was missing (harness#1047): a major update of a /vN Go module (go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 -> v4) rewrites go.mod against the old imports, so a PR that does not move the imports silently lowers the v3 requirement the code still compiles and adds an unused v4 line (harness#1046, msgbrowse#568). With it, the imports migrate in the same commit and tidy re-resolves, the shape cairn#492 landed.
The mod-downgrade-check gate in the Makefile is the backstop: a PR that lowers a requirement the base branch still compiles fails CI even if the bot config is wrong again.

customManagers.description: Bump the stack manifest's component tag and digest together (SPEC-0018 REQ-16)

Bump the manifest [plugin.*] skill pins (REQ-14). github-tags follows release tags; the two plugins still pinned to commit SHAs update once they cut tags (claude-plugin-switchboard#16, claude-plugin-cairn#11). A ref stays a tag, never a digest (REQ-14), so no pinDigests: a custom manager may not set it.
